Callout.Name: Kitchen Fire
Callout.Message: Kitchen fire in a flat, occupants out.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants evacuated by a neighbour, smoke from the window.

Script.Line: It was the chip pan. It went up the moment I put water near it.
Everybody is out. All four of us.
The flat door is open. I left it open so you could get in.

Lines.Approach: Everybody is out and the neighbour did the smoke alarm part. Smoke from the back window.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
